message: There is a water leak in Building C that has been running all morning.

output.escalation_reason: Active water leak represents ongoing resource waste and potential structural or slip hazard; same-day physical inspection and repair required
output.brief_summary: An employee reports a continuous water leak in Building C that has been running since at least that morning and requires urgent facilities intervention.

message: The recycling bins on Level 3 are contaminated again and no one seems to be checking them.

output.escalation_reason: Recurring contamination indicates a systemic oversight failure rather than a one-off incident; requires staff communication and a waste audit within 48 hours
output.brief_summary: An employee reports repeated recycling bin contamination on Level 3 with no apparent monitoring or corrective action in place.

message: I want to report that one of our suppliers may not meet our sustainability policy requirements.

output.escalation_reason: Potential supplier non-compliance with sustainability policy carries reputational and regulatory risk; requires formal review within 48 hours
output.brief_summary: An employee flags a concern that a supplier may be failing to meet the organisation's sustainability policy standards and requests a formal review.
